The Indian Women’s Hockey Team put up a determined fight against Australia in their virtual quarterfinal clash at the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, playing out a hard-fought 0–0 draw.
India battled hard throughout the contest, creating opportunities and keeping the pressure on Australia in a closely fought encounter before narrowly missing out on a semifinal spot.
Watch the highlights from the India vs Australia clash as the Indian Women’s Team gave it everything until the final hooter.
